title: Deutsche Inschriften Online (DIO)
institution: Die Deutschen Inschriften (Akademienunion; academies of Mainz, Göttingen, Düsseldorf, Heidelberg, Leipzig, Munich), with Epigraf (Digitale Akademie, Mainz)
license_note: Data dumps: CC BY 4.0 'where possible' (every article of the CGIF dump carries cc:by/4.0 as licence); images have their own, more restricted copyright. The portal itself shows a two-year moving wall after print publication.
notes: Edition of the printed series Die Deutschen Inschriften (Latin and German inscriptions up to 1650, some volumes later; whole database 31,197 articles dated 401-2022, of which 80 undated). Full transcriptions are published as EpiDoc only for DI 7 Braunschweig, DI 77 Greifswald and DI 102 Stralsund (978 articles). Other EpiDoc volumes are announced. The portal www.inschriften.net sits behind an Anubis bot check (returns a challenge page to curl), so its content was checked via the Epigraf dumps page, not the portal. Includes Austrian volumes of the Munich/Mainz series; the separate Viennese series (see oeaw-inschriften-wiener-reihe) is not part of it. The counts cover only the three volumes with published transcriptions (978 of 31,197 articles), and many dates are approximate. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
